description: A nested final group does not change the ownership of a capture in the outer option (engine §2.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text X r | Y r
%rule r ($a:aa (cc ≻ dd) ≻ $b:bb) :: ∅
%conditions $a.tags = A ∧ ¬$.preceded-by(X)
%rule aa A
%rule bb A B
%rule cc B
%rule dd B
